pattern.review_process: Early August (Aug 3 2023, Aug 2 2024, Aug 4 2026; Jun 25 2025), i.e. ~8-10 weeks after the deadline; rebuttal window 7 days in 2025-2026 (11-12 days in 2023-2024).

extra.review_process: Double-blind on OpenReview (robot-learning.org/CoRL/YYYY/Conference) with Area Chairs (plus Senior Area Chairs from 2026), aiming for at least two reviews per paper; reviews are released to authors followed by a one-page anonymous PDF rebuttal (no per-reviewer replies or paper updates in 2025-2026), then a reviewer-AC discussion week before decisions. Since 2026, papers with no score of weak accept or better are rejected without rebuttal. Reviews and rebuttals of accepted papers are made public; proceedings appear in PMLR.

resubmission_rules.dual_submission: Not allowed by default: submissions simultaneously under review at another archival venue are desk-rejected. Case-by-case exceptions when another venue's decision date slightly overlaps the CoRL review period (e.g. ICML decisions on May 1), only if the Publication Chair is notified before submission with the overlapping venue and dates.
resubmission_rules.arxiv: Permitted: 'Submission is permitted for papers that have previously appeared only as a technical report, e.g., in arXiv.' Papers previously published or accepted at an archival venue, or identical/substantially similar to such papers, are not accepted.
resubmission_rules.page_limit: 8 pages main text (acknowledgments, references, appendix and - since 2025 - the Limitations section excluded); camera-ready may use 9 pages from 2026.
resubmission_rules.author_list: Authors cannot be added or removed after the abstract deadline (2025-2026).
resubmission_rules.reciprocal_reviewing: Every author with 3 or more submissions must agree to serve as a reviewer (2025-2026).
resubmission_rules.planning_hint: CoRL decisions (early Sep) land after the ICRA deadline (mid-Sep) is nearly closed and before ICLR/RSS deadlines; a CoRL reject in early September can typically be turned around for ICLR (late Sep/early Oct) or RSS (late Jan/early Feb) - verify those venues' own dates.

Final version must closely match the accepted version ('changes only made to address the reviewers' comments'); in-person presentation by an author (or knowledgeable substitute) is expected; at least one author must register before the final upload.

pattern.review_process: Double-blind, fully public reviewing on OpenReview: reviews, author responses and the author-reviewer discussion are posted publicly (author names revealed only after decisions), followed by a private reviewer/AC discussion and meta-review. resubmission_rules.dual_submission: Submissions that are identical (or substantially similar) to versions that have been previously published, or accepted for publication, or that have been submitted in parallel to this or other conferences or journals, are not allowed and violate our dual submission policy.

resubmission_rules.submission_caps_2027: Max 20 submissions per author; at most one submission per author on which no co-author is an eligible reciprocal reviewer (first-time authors effectively limited to one paper).
resubmission_rules.rejected_papers: Rejected ICLR papers may be resubmitted elsewhere; reviews remain public on OpenReview. Withdrawn papers remain publicly visible and de-anonymized.
resubmission_rules.page_limit: 9 pages main text at submission (10 for rebuttal/camera-ready), references and appendix excluded.
